crew.overview: Franck is a firefighter in Paris. He saves people. He lives at the station with his wife, who is about to have twins. He’s happy. During a call out to a fire, he puts himself in danger, to save his men. He’s going to have to learn to live again and accept to be the one being saved, this time.
crew.title: Through the Fire

details.biography: Christophe LA PINTA is from Toulon where he lived until 19 years old. He enters the Conservatory at 6 years old in percussion class with Eliane DI MEO. After various orchestral experiences, he is at the same time drummer in various rock, jazz or variety formations.
details.name: Christophe La Pinta
